objective: Determine whether the M48 target-localized substrate electron-current partition difference is carried by a substrate-side electron quasi-Fermi-gradient, carrier-density, mobility/conductivity, or boundary-field reconstruction term on the unchanged M47 default-BGN-on self-consistent states.

execution_protocol.sentaurus_source: M47 exact-state TDR field exports, reused read-only
execution_protocol.vela_source: M47 exact-state accepted states and VTK diagnostics, reused read-only
execution_protocol.terminal_anchor_source: M48 frozen four-terminal component ledger, reused read-only

substrate_boundary.topology: Silicon boundary edges whose two endpoints are M47 substrate-contact nodes
substrate_boundary.normal: outward from the adjacent Silicon triangle

substrate_rows.definition: Silicon graph-distance layers from substrate contact nodes
report: median and p95 absolute cross-solver quasi-Fermi-gradient difference

transport_product.decomposition: three-factor Shapley decomposition of the boundary-normal reconstructed flux into density, mobility, and quasi-Fermi-gradient contributions
residuals: exported-field minus q*n*mu*grad(Phi_n) for each solver
terminal anchor minus boundary-integrated exported field for each solver

attribution_rules.primary_quantity: Vela-minus-Sentaurus substrate conventional electron terminal-current difference at the M49 target
attribution_rules.dominant_factor: largest absolute signed contribution among density, mobility, quasi-Fermi gradient, exported-field constitutive residual difference, and terminal-to-boundary reconstruction residual difference
attribution_rules.resolved_mechanism_gate: one factor explains at least 80 percent of the target substrate electron difference in absolute magnitude, the exact bridge closes, and the same normalized factor is target-localized
attribution_rules.target_localization: the normalized absolute factor contribution at n23 Vg=0.05 exceeds both n23 adjacent-gate values and the matched n19 Vg=0.05 value
attribution_rules.boundary_observable_gate: if the target terminal-to-boundary reconstruction residual exceeds 20 percent of the M48 substrate electron difference, field-based mechanism attribution is boundary-observable-limited
attribution_rules.causal_claim_guard: fixed-state spatial decomposition can identify the state variable and region carrying the terminal manifestation; it cannot assign a production-code defect or justify a default change without a separate intervention
attribution_rules.outcome_policy: resolved, mixed, null, or boundary-observable-limited outcomes are all valid completed results

forbidden_work: global HFS parameter scans or default tuning
BGN, SRH, mobility, contact, solver, or production-default changes
rewriting M8, M45, M46, M47, or M48 artifacts
deliverables: regression test for contract and evidence invariants
